findings.body: Once a task has merged the story document into origin/main, this lookup always selects main's version. Subsequent edits and re-approvals in the story's own checkout are ignored: an existing task with the old document passes validation and resumes its old conversation. The approval workflow explicitly finds the story checkout and commits approvals there (src/forge/approval.py:123 and :139; src/forge/story.py:359). Validate the current story's planning state and approval before checking the task's copy, including after the first task has merged.

findings.body: This new lockfile is outside the permitted scope and adds nothing needed for continuation, approval validation, or recovery. pyproject.toml:10 declares no runtime dependencies, and src/forge/codex.py:121 installs the pinned SDK separately in its managed environment. Remove the unrelated lockfile from this change.
